first_accepted_patch:
--- a/rtl/fsm_controller.v
+++ b/rtl/fsm_controller.v
@@ -46,7 +46,7 @@
                     if (car_present) begin
                         current_state <= S_MAIN_YELLOW;
                         timer_cnt     <= 4'd0;
-                    end else if (timer_cnt < TICKS_GREEN - 1'b1) begin
+                    end else if (timer_cnt < TICKS_GREEN) begin
                         timer_cnt <= timer_cnt + 1'b1;
                     end
                 end
final_patch:
--- a/rtl/fsm_controller.v
+++ b/rtl/fsm_controller.v
@@ -46,7 +46,7 @@
                     if (car_present) begin
                         current_state <= S_MAIN_YELLOW;
                         timer_cnt     <= 4'd0;
-                    end else if (timer_cnt < TICKS_GREEN - 1'b1) begin
+                    end else if (timer_cnt < TICKS_GREEN) begin
                         timer_cnt <= timer_cnt + 1'b1;
                     end
                 end

parsed_output.root_cause: The timer_cnt comparison in the S_MAIN_GREEN state uses TICKS_GREEN - 1'b1, causing the timer to count one tick fewer than required. This makes the FSM exit S_MAIN_GREEN prematurely, leading to an incorrect state_debug value observed during simulation.
